maya: Drafting a customer quick-start 'warmup' card to attach to onboarding emails. Focus: reduce early churn by lowering first-call latency. Keep wording simple.

celine.cs: Great. Customers often worry about data persistence. Let's include a short FAQ line: 'No model training or new retention beyond standard logs.'

alex.sre: Minimal vendor-safe recipe:
1) Verify region & model with CS rep
2) Issue 3 small prefill hits spaced 15s apart (max_tokens=20)
3) Open 1 streaming request, confirm chunking within 2s
4) Set TTL on prefill keys to 45m or use ephemeral flag

maya: sample customer curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
  -H "X-Prefill-TTL:45m" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite-1","input":"<sample prompt>"}'
```

tom.cs: internal ops: avoid bursting; cap prefill qps to 0.2 per account for low-touch. If prefill is rate-limited, schedule retry at +60s.

cs-bot: Action: create an account dashboard card to show last warmup run. Owners: cs-team + eng-platform.

maya: I'll write the one-pager and include rollback commands for SRE. Will post tomorrow for a quick review.
